_review: DRAFT v1 — fleet-wide effects assume campaign-stat handlers via FleetMemberAPI and CampaignFleetAPI. Numbers untuned.

nodes.name: Fleet Command
nodes._review: Vanilla base regen is slow; 5% is nearly invisible. Consider +1 CP flat or +25% regen.

nodes.name: Signal Discipline
nodes._review: Handler must modify MutableCharacterStatsAPI.getOfficerNumberBonus(). Vanilla formula may clamp.

nodes.name: Coordinated Strikes
nodes.desc: +5% damage to ships targeted by multiple allies.
nodes._review: Requires per-combat target-tracking plugin — non-trivial handler. May reduce to simple fleet damage boost.

nodes.name: Bombardment Doctrine
nodes._review: Fleet-wide missile buff — pairs poorly with missile-heavy officer builds. Consider 0.10.

nodes.name: Force Concentration
nodes.desc: +1 additional officer can be assigned to the same ship type (cruiser/capital).
nodes._review: Description mismatch — current effect is generic slot. Either rework handler or rewrite desc to match.

nodes.name: Grand Admiral
nodes.desc: All fleet ships +10% CR at start of battle, +5% top speed. (Capstone)
nodes._review: CR start bonus is vanilla Coordinated Maneuvers territory. Stacks — confirm cap.

nodes.name: Fleet Logistics
nodes._review: Negative amount = reduction. Handler must mirror sign convention for stacking.

nodes.name: Fuel Economy
nodes._review: Vanilla Navigation gives -10% — keep this skill larger to justify investment.

nodes.name: Crew Training
nodes.desc: +20% max CR for all ships in fleet.
nodes._review: Max CR above 70% is powerful — consider soft cap via handler.

nodes.name: Iron Stomach
nodes._review: Stacks with logistics_1 and logistics_3 — total supply reduction could hit -35%. Balance via handler cap.

nodes.name: Carrier Wing Discipline
nodes._review: Replacement rate is a cap — handler must not exceed vanilla max of 1.0.

nodes.name: Phase Doctrine
nodes.desc: Phase ships in fleet: +15% flux dissipation, -10% phase cloak upkeep.
nodes._review: Phase-ship filtering requires handler to check hull tags. Nice to have, niche use.

nodes.name: Elite Forces
nodes.desc: +1 elite skill slot on each officer (beyond vanilla).
nodes._review: Stacks with vanilla Officer Management. Very powerful — consider 'chance of extra elite skill' instead of guaranteed.

nodes.name: Carrier Admiral
nodes.desc: Fighters in fleet: +25% damage, +25% HP, +30% replacement rate. (Capstone)
nodes._review: Overlaps doctrine_1 replacement rate — confirm stacking intended (currently +40% total).
